Col G is written by `sync_stance_g.py:20-21` WITH the Tier-1 crown, so the replacement was not equivalent: all 12 Champions read as Ally / Highly Persuadable, and since `COMMITTED={'Champion','Opponent'}` exists so terminal rungs cannot be bought away, **all 12 silently lost money-defection immunity** ($500k competitor shock defected Fitzpatrick). **Why nothing caught it: the existing immunity check INJECTS `OV[probe]='Opponent'`**, so it passes regardless of whether real members reach that rung, and there was no Champion equivalent. *A guard that tests the mechanism with synthetic input proves nothing about whether real data reaches it.* Fix: `money_response` now uses `sync_stance_g`'s exact recipe (`legislative_press_tiers(list(MAT))` + `overall_display_tier`), so engine and col G cannot diverge; missing-member default 'Neutral' -> none (a missing stance is not a neutral one; '-' no-position ontology; latent, 0/533 missing); + 2 audit checks (a REAL Champion-immunity check that FAILS on an empty Champion list, and an `OV[m] == overall_display_tier(...)` equivalence assertion).
